items.html: And these are the two corrections of the hairs: the upper ones are one correction, which is the eighth; and the lower ones, which are covered by them, are another, second correction, and it is the thirteenth correction, the last of them all. And behold, these hairs are very long, and they extend and reach the navel of AA, to half of his Tifferet, where the beginning of the head of ZA is, as was said.
